plugins.name: mary
plugins.description: Hallucination-prevention harness for Claude Code. Six-stage procedure: separate verifiable claims from judgment, verify against observable evidence, attack the output with a read-only critic, re-verify, and keep failure records that survive sessions. Installs no hooks; an approval gate is available as an opt-in extra.
